# Chapter 14: Bad Dog

*From BookSource.txt, Page 60*

The summer I turned seven, we got a dog. His name was Max, and he was supposed to be a guard dog - a fierce protector for our family. Instead, he became something else entirely: my first real friend.

Max was a German Shepherd with a coat as black as midnight. My father had bought him from a breeder, hoping he'd be tough, intimidating. But Max had other plans.
